title: Weibo Lifestyle UGC Scraper Input
description: Input parameters for scraping lifestyle-related user-generated content (UGC) posts from Weibo.

keywords.title: Search Keywords
keywords.description: List of lifestyle-related keywords to scrape from Weibo (e.g., 护肤, 健身, 旅行, 穿搭, 美食).

max_pages.title: Max Pages per Keyword
max_pages.description: Maximum number of Weibo search result pages to scrape per keyword (1–10).

concurrency.title: Concurrency Level
concurrency.description: Number of concurrent requests for scraping posts (1–20).
